_figma_help: One design_system file per project. design_files is a list of {name, url, file_key, role: screens|source, content: frames|screenshots|mixed, library_updates_accepted: true|false}. file_key is the part of the URL after /design/ or /file/. layout: separate (default) | single-file (Scenario C, DS inside the Design file, Intake section 7g: design_system and design_files[0] share one file_key, ds_pages lists the DS page names, library_updates_accepted is null and publish is replaced by history versions).
_team_help: Intake 0.3d: collaboration solo | team. Team only (steps/team.md): team = {repo: <GitHub URL>, locks: [{component, by, since}]}; the project folder is one repo with its Storybook; tools/team_sync.cjs pulls, pushes and locks.
_sync_help: figma.design_system.storybook_synced_version: {id, created_at} of the DS file's Figma history version the Storybook was last synced with. Written by python tools/project_status.py "<folder>" --mark-synced (or node tools/figma_versions.cjs "<folder>" --record); the session-start Figma edit check reports newer versions, manual edits included.
_mobile_help: Mobile projects only (intake 1.3-1.5). mobile_setup: native | cross-platform | mobile-adaptive. Both + native: this folder is one platform (iOS or Android); sibling_project is the other platform folder (e.g. My Projects/Music App_Android/); its Design files are linked only to this folder's DS. brand_foundation (optional, native only): {name, url, file_key} of 'Music App Brand Foundation' (Primitives only), copied into this DS as local Primitives, never enabled as a library.
_storybook_help: storybook_plan: yes | later | no (intake 0.7). storybook_ask_at when later: components-approved | screens-approved | next-session. Register Design files with: python tools/project_status.py "<folder>" --add-design-file <url> --name "<name>".
_code_help: Scenario D (Code to Design, Intake section 6) only. code_to_design: existing-ds | new-ds. source_code: {repo, branch, path, preview_url}. existing-ds: figma.design_system.shared is true and editable_pages lists the only DS pages that may be written; design_files may hold a role: reference entry (read only).
_icons_help: Intake 0.6b: {library: lucide | sf-symbols-style | material-symbols | phosphor | tabler | heroicons | remix | existing | <other id>, source: file or library name when existing, style: weight and outline/fill}. Library details and licenses: tools/icon_libraries.json.
_app_icon_help: Set when ➜ App Icon is created (Intake section 7h): {status: waiting | presented, appearances: [names made, e.g. Default, Dark, Tinted / Foreground, Background, Monochrome / Light, Dark, Maskable], last_update: date}. A session that finds status waiting checks the drop zones once, read-only.
